items.stem: A change spans several Python modules and their tests. Which Cursor surface fits best?

options.text: The agent, scoped to the task with a review of its diffs
options.rationale: Correct: the agent handles multi-file tasks; diffs are then reviewed.

options.text: A single inline edit on one line
options.rationale: Inline edit targets small local changes, not multi-file work.

options.text: Copying code out to a separate chat tool
options.rationale: That discards project context Cursor already has.
Renaming does not address making the multi-file change.

items.explanation: Correct: the agent handles multi-file tasks; diffs are then reviewed.

items.stem: Which TWO habits keep AI-assisted Python changes safe to ship? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Read and review every diff before accepting it
options.rationale: Correct: human review catches unintended or wrong changes.

options.text: Run the tests and check they assert the intended behaviour
options.rationale: Correct: passing tests only help if they assert the right thing.

options.text: Accept all agent changes to save time
options.rationale: Unreviewed sweeping changes are how defects slip in.

options.text: Paste production secrets into the prompt for context
options.rationale: Secrets must be kept out of prompts.

items.explanation: Correct: human review catches unintended or wrong changes.

items.stem: A pytest run fails. What is the most effective next step in Cursor?

options.text: Give the failing test output to Cursor as context for a targeted fix
options.rationale: Correct: error output is strong context for a focused correction.

options.text: Delete the failing test so the suite passes
options.rationale: Deleting the test hides the defect instead of fixing it.

options.text: Ask the agent to rewrite the whole module blind
options.rationale: A blind rewrite ignores the specific failure.

options.text: Commit anyway and fix it later
options.rationale: Committing a known failure breaks the build.

items.explanation: Correct: error output is strong context for a focused correction.
